stories.title_ja: コミュニティガーデン
stories.title: The Community Garden
stories.summary: A group of neighbors decides to transform an empty lot into a vibrant community garden. They learn to plant vegetables and flowers together. Soon, the garden brings fresh produce and new friendships to the neighborhood.

stories.title: The Lost Parrot
stories.summary: A young boy's pet parrot flies out an open window. He posts flyers and searches the neighborhood for days. Finally, a kind old woman calls, saying she found his colorful bird.

stories.title_ja: スマートウォッチの冒険
stories.title: The Smartwatch Adventure
stories.summary: A girl gets a new smartwatch for her birthday. It helps her track her steps, find new places, and even communicate with friends. One day, it unexpectedly leads her to a hidden park.

stories.title_ja: コーヒーショップの夢
stories.title: The Coffee Shop Dream
stories.summary: A young woman always dreamed of opening her own small coffee shop. She saves money and learns to make delicious drinks. Her cozy shop quickly becomes a favorite spot in town.

stories.title_ja: ビーチクリーンアップの日
stories.title: Beach Cleanup Day
stories.summary: A school organizes a beach cleanup day. Students pick up plastic and other trash, making the beach beautiful again. They learn about protecting the ocean and local wildlife.
grammar_points: ではありませんでした(dewa arimasen deshita)

stories.title: The Mystery Baker
stories.summary: Every morning, fresh, warm bread appears on the doorstep of an elderly neighbor. No one knows who the baker is. The neighbor eventually discovers it's a shy young student from next door.
